scope: Read-only inspection of the fixed patched core and existing retention tests; no frozen core/product implementation changes by this verifier, no QA profile/port access
finding: Changing only logRetentionDays previously saved activity_retention_days/logging.max_age without restarting the core; the activity maxAge and existing lumberjack sink retain initialization-time values. Parent is fixing the desktop SaveSettings restart condition.

semantics.activity: Configured days become maxAge at Runtime initialization. Cleanup runs once on ActivityService startup and then every activity_cleanup_interval_min (default 60 minutes), pruning by record timestamp; count and size caps can remove records earlier.
semantics.files: logging.max_age becomes lumberjack MaxAge at sink creation. It removes rotated backup files based on timestamps in their names when cleanup is triggered by file opening/creation/rotation; it does not remove older individual lines from the current active log file.
semantics.hot_reload: DetectConfigChanges labels logging as changed without requiring restart. applyComponentConfigLocked only updates upstreamManager log config; it does not reconfigure the existing main logger or ActivityService retention parameters.
